TPaired.detail: Paired t test, matched missing-value handling, selected confidence level and optional agreement plot (vector PDF).

TSingle.detail: Student t test; the independent-samples script reports both pooled-variance and Welch results.

TUnpaired.detail: Student t test; the independent-samples script reports both pooled-variance and Welch results.

TSingleSummary.detail: Student t statistics and confidence intervals from the recorded summary inputs; both pooled and Welch for two groups.

TUnpairedSummary.detail: Student t statistics and confidence intervals from the recorded summary inputs; both pooled and Welch for two groups.

ExactSign.detail: Exact binomial test and confidence interval. Additional mid-P, approximation and two-sided conventions can differ.

PropSingle.detail: Exact binomial test and confidence interval. Additional mid-P, approximation and two-sided conventions can differ.

RatePoissonCI.detail: Exact Poisson rate estimate and confidence interval.

Chi2by2.detail: Pearson/G tests and requested Fisher or Monte Carlo tests. Trend, mid-P and additional risk estimates are not reproduced; simulation streams differ.

ExactFisher.detail: Pearson/G tests and requested Fisher or Monte Carlo tests. Trend, mid-P and additional risk estimates are not reproduced; simulation streams differ.

ExactFisherX.detail: Pearson/G tests and requested Fisher or Monte Carlo tests. Trend, mid-P and additional risk estimates are not reproduced; simulation streams differ.

ExactORCML.detail: Pearson/G tests and requested Fisher or Monte Carlo tests. Trend, mid-P and additional risk estimates are not reproduced; simulation streams differ.

ExactFisherRbyC.detail: Pearson/G tests and requested Fisher or Monte Carlo tests. Trend, mid-P and additional risk estimates are not reproduced; simulation streams differ.

ExactChiRbyC.detail: Pearson/G tests and requested Fisher or Monte Carlo tests. Trend, mid-P and additional risk estimates are not reproduced; simulation streams differ.

ExactChiRbyCScreen.detail: Pearson/G tests and requested Fisher or Monte Carlo tests. Trend, mid-P and additional risk estimates are not reproduced; simulation streams differ.

ExactMcNamar.detail: McNemar tests with and without continuity correction and exact discordant-pair binomial test.

ExactMcNamarChi.detail: McNemar tests with and without continuity correction and exact discordant-pair binomial test.

Spearman.detail: Rank correlation. R exact/asymptotic calculations and treatment of ties can give different P values.

Kendall.detail: Rank correlation. R exact/asymptotic calculations and treatment of ties can give different P values.

Wilcoxon.detail: Corresponding base-R rank/distribution test. Exact algorithms, ties and continuity corrections may differ.

MannWhitney.detail: Corresponding base-R rank/distribution test. Exact algorithms, ties and continuity corrections may differ.

Smirnov.detail: Corresponding base-R rank/distribution test. Exact algorithms, ties and continuity corrections may differ.

Kruskal.detail: Corresponding base-R rank/distribution test. Exact algorithms, ties and continuity corrections may differ.

OneWay.detail: One-way ANOVA main test. Supplementary comparisons are left for explicit selection in R.

SimpleLinearRegression.detail: Simple linear regression, coefficient confidence intervals and an editable lm model.

VarianceRatio.detail: F variance-ratio test, placing the larger variance in the numerator as StatsDirect does.

UnivariateSummary.detail: Core descriptive statistics and mean confidence intervals. R type-7 quantiles are explicit; additional StatsDirect summaries are not reproduced.

QuickSummary.detail: Core descriptive statistics and mean confidence intervals. R type-7 quantiles are explicit; additional StatsDirect summaries are not reproduced.

UnivariateSummaryToWorksheetOnly.detail: Core descriptive statistics and mean confidence intervals. R type-7 quantiles are explicit; additional StatsDirect summaries are not reproduced.

Normality.detail: Shapiro-Wilk test. Other normality diagnostics in the report are not reproduced; R accepts 3 to 5000 observations.

DistributionNormal.detail: Corresponding base-R distribution probabilities using the recorded form values.

DistributionT.detail: Corresponding base-R distribution probabilities using the recorded form values.
